title: Taxonomy Term Record
description: One node in a scheme (SKOS Concept): a product class, a subject category, a review-page category, an attribute definition. Hierarchy by parent_id (broader); extra broader terms and 'related' via relations. `data.path` is the dotted slug path written into other records' `category[<dimension>]`, so a prefix match on 'engineering' finds 'engineering.mechanical.fasteners'. Replaces content_category (website category pages keep their SEO block in data.seo) and the engineering-reference/review-page nodes.json category shape.

relations.description: rel='in_scheme' (required in practice), optional rel='broader' for extra parents, rel='related' for see-also.

scheme.description: Scheme slug (denormalized for convenience; rel='in_scheme' is authoritative).

notation.description: Stable code within the scheme: EC000466, 31171504, 8482.10, PT-07-018.

path.description: Dotted slug path from the root, recomputed by the toolchain when a term moves or is renamed.

level.description: Depth in the tree, 0 = top. Derived from the parent chain; do not edit.

scope_note.description: What does not belong, or how to choose between close terms.

key.description: Attribute term slug from the `attributes` scheme.

required.description: True if every product in this class must have the attribute.

facet.description: Show as a search/filter facet (RFQ, product search).

attributes.description: Attribute template for product classes: which specs a product in this class should have. Drives product forms, RFQ facets and completeness checks.

datatype.description: Kind of value the attribute holds.

unit.description: Unit of the value, e.g. V, mm.

unit_dimension.description: Physical dimension, e.g. voltage, length, so units can convert.

allowed_values.description: Values allowed for an enum attribute.

attribute_def.description: Only for terms in the `attributes` scheme: the definition of one spec key.

title.description: Page title for the category page.

description.description: Meta description for the category page.

seo.description: Website category-page metadata (review page, engineering reference).

publish.description: Show on public sites. Replaces the nodes.json 'published' / 'not-published' status.
